summary: refactor(settings): scope inline TOTP MFA guard to enrolment step
description:
Because:
- The inline TOTP flow requested an email OTP on page load, before the
  user saw the "set up two-step authentication" intro.
- Users who never proceed past the intro were forced through an
  unnecessary email-OTP round-trip.

This commit:
- Container owns currentStep and MfaGuardCore; index.tsx is presentational.
- InlineTotpEnrolment (JWT createTotp/verify) runs under the guard at step 1.
- OTP appears after Continue; dismiss returns to intro; card spinner while loading.
- Reorder functional inline TOTP specs to confirm the guard after Continue.
- Split unit tests into enrolment, presentational shell, and container wiring.
